newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ocean vessel, seaborne cargo in HK rose in Q4 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ocean vessel, seaborne cargo in HK rose in Q4 1996.

text.p: Hong Kong's Census and Statistics Department said on Friday 10,788 ocean vessels with a total capacity of 47.3 million net registered tons entered Hong Kong in the fourth quarter of 1996.
This represented an increase of one percent in the number of vessels and six percent in capacity compared with the same period of 1995, it said in a statement.
It said there were 10,829 outgoing ocean vessels with a total capacity of 47.2 million net registered tons, a rise of five percent in capacity versus the same period in 1995.

In the fourth quarter of 1996, the total tonnage of seaborne inward cargo, comprising seaborne imports and seaborne inward transhipment, was estimated at 23.2 million tonnes, representing an increase of four percent over the same quarter of 1995.
